description: Returns one saved Suunto route by id: { id, description, visibility, activityIds, startPoint, centerPoint, endPoint (latitude, longitude, altitude), totalDistance (m), averageSpeed, created, modified (epoch ms), watchEnabled (true = offered to the watch), turnWaypointsEnabled }. Works for any route, including ones list_routes does not show (it returns at most 5). Whether the route is actually on the watch cannot be seen here — that is decided by the Suunto app's sync. Use export_route for the track. Read-only.

routeId.description: Route ID, e.g. from upload_route or list_routes.

name: get_route
title: Get route
